messages:
sara: dropping a short design thread on the docs panel copy + links. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz-panel. main thing: we have slightly different labels in the console vs docs (Console: 'Batching guide' vs Docs H1: 'Batching'). should we normalize to nouns across nav or keep contextual CTAs?
lee: prefer nouns for nav (less verb-y). inside the panel use contextual CTAs: e.g., label 'Batching' + button 'Open batching guide'. keeps both compact and descriptive.
amar: +1. tiny accessibility concern: if we surface CTA text that repeats H1 verbatim it can be confusing for screen reader users. better to have unique accessible name for the link: aria-label="Open batching guide (opens in new tab)".
sara: good — also question about deep links. team is split between using fragments (#batching) and query params (?src=panel). thoughts on maintainability?
lee: fragments are stable for direct anchor jumps, humans like them. keep ?src=panel for telemetry but put it before the hash: /docs/console?src=panel#batching. avoids breaking anchor resolution.
amar: minor lexicon nit: our console uses "Docs" in some places and "Guides" in others. can we pick one? i vote for "Docs" for top-level links and use "guide" in CTAs when pointing at how-to content.
sara: agree. policy: top-level nav = "Docs", contextual CTA = "guide" or "guide: <topic>". add this to the console style token list.
lee: iconography: we'll add a micro external-link icon (10px) for links going to the docs site; design token name `icon.external.docs`. devs: pls make sure component adds rel="noopener noreferrer" and target="_blank" when using that token.
amar: telemetry: propose event name `docs.panel.link_click` with props: ["src", "anchor", "link_text"]. pls avoid PII in link_text and prefer using stable slugs.
sara: small a11y checklist: focus visible, aria-expanded on the panel toggle, role="dialog" on the panel, aria-live="polite" for description updates when focus changes. add keyboard shortcut hint in the footer: 'Press ? for shortcuts'.
docs-bot: docs action: creating stable heading ids in repo -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412.
sara: ok i'll update figma + add an acceptance criteria checklist on the ticket: copy tokens, aria labels, telemetry specs, link behavior (new tab + rel), and lexicon mapping (Docs vs Guide). will ping design + docs to review. thanks :thumbsup:
summary: Design thread to harmonize console docs-panel labels and cross-links: use nouns for nav and contextual CTAs inside the panel, prefer fragment anchors with a src query param for telemetry, standardize top-level 'Docs' vs CTA 'guide', add external-link icon and new-tab behavior, specify aria labels and a11y checklist, and define telemetry event schema. References docs PR for stable heading ids.
